headline: CNG driver injured in cocktail blast outside July Memorial Museum
summary: A 45-year-old driver was hit by splinters from a crude bomb explosion in Dhaka on Wednesday night.
details: A CNG autorickshaw driver was injured in a crude bomb explosion outside the July Memorial Museum in Dhaka on Wednesday night.
The incident occurred around 10:45 pm in front of the museum’s Gate No. 1.
The injured man, identified as 45-year-old Shaheen, also known as Arif Molla, was hit by splinters from the blast.
According to Sub-Inspector Mahbub Alam of Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station, criminals threw two crude bombs, one of which exploded.
Shaheen, who hails from Tangail’s Nagarpur and lives in Jatrabari, was first taken to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital.
He was later transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) around 1 am for advanced treatment.
Police stated that they have not yet discovered who conducted the attack or the motive behind it.
caption:
A crude bomb blast outside the July Memorial Museum in Dhaka has left a CNG driver injured.

According to Sub-Inspector Mahbub Alam of Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Police Station, criminals threw two crude bombs, one of which exploded.

Shaheen, who hails from Tangail’s Nagarpur and lives in Jatrabari, was first taken to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital.

He was later transferred to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) around 1 am for advanced treatment.

Police stated that they have not yet discovered who conducted the attack or the motive behind it.

headline_marked: 1,702 candidates [[appointed to different cadres under 45th BCS]]
headline: 1,702 candidates appointed to different cadres under 45th BCS
summary: The Ministry of Public Administration has issued the final gazette, directing new recruits to join their respective offices by November 1.
details: The Ministry of Public Administration has published the final gazette for the 45th BCS, appointing 1,702 candidates to various cadres.
The notification was issued on Wednesday night, October 14. New recruits are instructed to join their respective cadre-controlling ministries or departments by November 1.

The appointments follow the recommendations of the Bangladesh Public Service Commission (PSC) dated December 14, 2025. Recruits will be employed in the 9th grade under the National Pay Scale 2026, with salaries ranging from 44,000 to 105,900 BDT.
The 45th BCS process began with the circular in November 2022. Preliminary exams were held in May 2023, followed by written exams in January 2024.
Oral examinations were conducted in stages starting July 8, 2025. The PSC published the final results on November 26, 2025, recommending 1,807 candidates.
The final appointment gazette has been released more than 10 months after the initial final recommendation.
caption:
1,702 candidates have officially been appointed to the 45th BCS. The final gazette is out!

The Ministry of Public Administration has published the final gazette for the 45th BCS, appointing 1,702 candidates to various cadres.

The notification was issued on Wednesday night, October 14. New recruits are instructed to join their respective cadre-controlling ministries or departments by November 1.

The appointments follow the recommendations of the Bangladesh Public Service Commission (PSC) dated December 14, 2025. Recruits will be employed in the 9th grade under the National Pay Scale 2026, with salaries ranging from 44,000 to 105,900 BDT.

The 45th BCS process began with the circular in November 2022. Preliminary exams were held in May 2023, followed by written exams in January 2024.

Oral examinations were conducted in stages starting July 8, 2025. The PSC published the final results on November 26, 2025, recommending 1,807 candidates.

The final appointment gazette has been released more than 10 months after the initial final recommendation.
